channel.title: Comments on: Firefox 2 tip: autocomplete in search box
channel.description: Instant Usability & Web Standards — static archive

item.title: By: Thomas Watson Steen
item.dc:creator: Thomas Watson Steen
item.description:
As far as I can see, it works great with Euros. Try for example “123 DKK in EUR“.

But for some reason I do not see the auto complete working with currency conversion directly in the browser :(

item.title: By: Ron Derksen
item.dc:creator: Ron Derksen
item.description: Sadly, the currency conversion only works to US Dollars, and not to Euros.
